datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
A tennis ball is launched with speed u0 at an angle ϕ above the horizontal
A. u0. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because the vertical component changes due to gravity, so the total speed
generally decreases before the peak.
B. u0 cos ϕ. [correct] Explanation: This is correct because at the top the vertical velocity is zero while the horizontal component
remains u0 cos ϕ, so the speed equals that value.
C. u0 sin ϕ. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because u0 sin ϕ is the initial vertical component, which is not the speed at
maximum height.
D. 0. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because only the vertical component becomes zero at the top, not the horizontal
component.
